newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN CALL MONEY FIRM, BUT NO REPO CHANGE SEEN YET.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN CALL MONEY FIRM, BUT NO REPO CHANGE SEEN YET.

text.p: German call money remained firm on Monday amid continued, albeit waning, speculation that the Bundesbank was about to signal that five years of easier monetary policy is at an end.
Dealers said the recent ease in the U.S. dollar from a 1997 peak of just over 1.89 marks had contributed to a dampening in speculation that the central bank would signal a move as early as this week.
But the view persisted in the market that it was now only a matter of time before the central bank switched to a course of tighter monetary policy.
